description: OVERALL RESPOSIBILITIES The HR Specialist is responsible for the onboarding process, HRIS management, and providing overall administrative, logistical, and coordination support to the Country team. The HR Specialist will be involved in additional HRM projects, as requested. They handle information and documents relevant to human resources with a high degree of confidentiality, discretion, and attention to detail. Participate in recruitment activities based on the position grade and organizational requirements. Support HR administrative activities, including scheduling assessments and interviews, conducting reference checks, and maintaining recruitment documentation. Ensure employees receive identity and health insurance cards and complete all required enrollment forms. Process work permits and related documentation for expatriate employees. Coordinate employee orientation sessions, including interim orientation during the first week of employment and general orientation on a monthly basis. Follow up with supervisors and new employees to ensure all onboarding requirements are completed. Maintain and provide weekly updates to the onboarding tracker. Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee information in HR databases and payroll systems. Ensure relevant employment changes are communicated promptly to employees and concerned stakeholders. Conduct annual personnel file audits and address any identified gaps or discrepancies in a timely manner. Provide departing employees with relevant benefits and separation information. Schedule and coordinate exit interviews and ensure required separation documentation is completed.
